title: TRIVING PAGES 3N2 FI–17/06/2026)
summary: TODAYOURIST was honored to accompany the Chi of the 28th Street War veterans – GE Long Ping – TP. The Nai Plain on a holiday tour in the beautiful coastal city.

content.text: TODAYOURIST was honored to accompany the Chi of the 28th Street War veterans – GE Long Ping – TP. The Nai Plain on a holiday tour in the beautiful coastal city.

The journey was not just an opportunity to rest, to relax, but also an opportunity for the uncles and siblings to review beautiful memories together, to increase the bond of unity, and to hold many memorable moments together.
Check in the archetype at the Manor Church
Travel, join the blue sea – White sand – golden sun
Relaxing, Health Cares with the Spanish-specific mud bath experience Page
Visiting Ning Shun Gardens, enjoying local specials
The night Gala Dinner is warm with many laughter, communication and collective binding
Each journey is a beautiful memory, each destination is a memorable experience.
Ladies and gentlemen, you have great health, fun and always maintain a positive, united spirit. See you on the next journeys with TODAYTURIST!
